feature: ring-hash child policy inside SharedChannel weighted_target

scope.ring: grpc-core-compatible weighted ketama over child-local logical sources

contracts: weighted_target selects one READY child before delegating to its picker
each ring-hash child owns independent ring size and request-hash-header configuration
metadata hash overrides the explicit request-hash attribute
a missing configured header uses random fallback
explicit hashes stick to a pending primary and walk clockwise past a failed primary

implementation.hash_timing: Job computes the request hash only after the weighted child is selected, using that leaf configuration
implementation.ownership: unary uses cloned Job metadata and streaming uses retained StreamCall options
implementation.logical_sources: the ring contains only sources under the leaf hierarchical prefix
implementation.duplicates: exact endpoint duplicates collapse before worker creation and their ring weights are summed
implementation.membership: ring snapshots invalidate on source promotion and worker retirement
implementation.routing: leaf-local ketama selection maps local ring ordinals back to parent source indices
implementation.fallback: TRANSIENT_FAILURE sources are skipped clockwise; CONNECTING or saturated explicit primaries remain sticky

assertions: x-shard a_0 overrides an explicit b_0 attribute and routes to a
x-shard b_0 overrides an explicit a_0 attribute and routes to b
x-shard c_0 walks from failed c to a healthy clockwise successor
duplex x-shard b_0 uses the retained streaming metadata and routes to b
two duplicate a endpoints with weights 1 and 2 produce one logical owner

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC SharedChannel weighted target ring hash' --summary all
remaining_gap: weighted-round-robin, outlier children, resolver churn, and ordinary Channel remain before broad weighted_target completion
